Pocket-size.Description: Illegally small guns. Do not the gun
Pocket-size.Explanation: This weapon fits in one hand and can be equiped in holster slot. With a boost to ergonomics and almost weightless!

Rifle Grenade Launcher.Description:
- It's like an underbarrel grenade launcher, but instead, it's an in-barrel grenade launcher!
- You mean a rifle grenade…?
- Exactly what I have in mind!
Rifle Grenade Launcher.Explanation: Weapon variant additionary chambered in 40mm grenades with slightly increased muzzle velocity. So, when you are out of ammo, just load grenade launcher rounds directly into the chamber!

Bombardier.Description: God has blessed this weapon with a very big... cylinder. And an absurd amount of firepower!
Bombardier.Explanation: A revolver that dreams of being a grenade launcher

Holster.Explanation: SMG variant that trades its fire rate for more ergonomics and ability to be held in holster slot

Glass Cannon.Description: It's neither made of glass nor actually a cannon - but look at it. When you fire it, it's definitely a cannon, and when you check its durability, it's definitely glass
Glass Cannon.Explanation: Shotgun variant chambered in .50 BMG with a 1-round magazine. Features increased durability damage but can be held in the pistol slot
